message: I want to book an appointment
Please provide your name for the booking.
Great, Shishir! What type of appointment are you looking to book, and do you have a preferred date and time?

I'm here to assist you, but I don't have direct access to external systems or services to book appointments. I recommend contacting your dental office directly to book your checkup for October 1, 2025, at 2:30 PM. You can usually do this by phone, their website, or through an email.

If you need help with what to say when booking or any other assistance related to your appointment, feel free to ask!
